prospects.author: Bernard of Clairvaux
prospects.title: On Loving God
prospects.rejection_reason: Translator E.G. Gardner died 1935, after the 1928 copyright cutoff. Translation not in public domain until 2031 under 95-year rule. Re-add with an older translation if a suitable one can be identified.
prospects.notes: Gardner died 1935 — translation entered US public domain in 2031 under 95-year rule. Stage 1 should flag this and reject or source an older translation. Terence Connolly (1937) is also still in copyright. The Hugh Martin translation (1916, d. unknown) may be safer — verify at Stage 1.

prospects.author: Martin Luther
prospects.title: Small Catechism
prospects.notes: Stage 1 must identify which English translation the Wikisource edition uses and confirm translator death year < 1928. The 1912 Concordia edition (F. Bente / W.H.T. Dau) is one candidate — verify death dates. If Wikisource translation is in copyright, try Archive.org for a 19th-century edition. Luther d. 1546 so the work itself is clear.

prospects.author: John Keble
prospects.title: National Apostasy
prospects.notes: Original English — no translator. Keble d. 1866. Single sermon preached 14 July 1833, widely regarded as the founding moment of the Oxford Movement. Short text. Clean HTML on Project Canterbury (anglicanhistory.org). Will need an editorial introduction contextualising the Oxford Movement for readers arriving cold.

prospects.author: Anonymous (Ante-Nicene)
prospects.title: The Epistle to Diognetus
prospects.notes: Anonymous 2nd-century apologetic letter — author unknown, no death year. Copyright clear via translation: Roberts-Donaldson ANF Vol. 1, 1885 (Alexander Roberts d. 1901, James Donaldson d. 1915). New Advent broken for /fathers/ URLs — use Archive.org ANF Vol. 1 OCR. Stage 1: verify the Archive.org identifier 'antenicanefathers01robe' is the correct volume and that Diognetus appears within it.

prospects.author: John Newton
prospects.title: Cardiphonia: Letters on the Spiritual Life (selection)
prospects.notes: Original English — no translator. Newton d. 1807. 1911 digitised edition on Archive.org (cardiphoniaorutt00newtuoft). Full volume is 300+ letters; pipeline should extract a curated selection of 10–15 by theme (interior life, spiritual direction, practical piety). Individual letters are self-contained and short. Stage 2 requires editorial judgment on letter selection rather than cleaning the full volume.

prospects.author: Justin Martyr
prospects.title: Dialogue with Trypho
prospects.notes: ANF Vol. 1, Dods & Reith translation 1885 (Marcus Dods d. 1909, George Reith d. 1916). New Advent broken. Long work — 138 chapters likely best imported as collection split by section. Notion backlog flags this as 'READY in Drive' meaning prep work may already be done — check with Keith whether a pre-processed version exists before running full OCR pipeline.

prospects.author: Samuel Rutherford
prospects.title: Letters of Samuel Rutherford (selection)
prospects.notes: Original 17th-century English — no translator. Rutherford d. 1661. Bonar's 1891 edition (letterssamuelru00bonagoog): 744 pages, 365 letters. Significant editorial curation required — pipeline should extract 15–20 letters rather than the full volume. Prioritise letters from Anwoth (pre-1636) and Aberdeen exile (1636–38) for highest devotional intensity.
